acceptance/test_average_daily_demand.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.average_daily_demand import average_daily_demand

LINES = [
    "1;SHP;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;7 EA",
    "2;SHP;ABC-123456-1;A-01-01-1;1 CS",
    "2;RCV;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;5 CS",
    "# day 3",
    "3;RTN;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;4 EA",
    "5;SHP;KIT-200001-3;A-01-01-1;9 EA",
    "8;SHP;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;2 EA",
]
SIZES = {"ABC-123456-1": 6}


def test_window():
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "KIT-200001-3", 1, 10) == 1
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 4, 8) == 1
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "TEE-104520-4", 1, 30) == 0


def test_returns():
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 1, 4) == 3
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 3, 3) == 0


def test_bad_range():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 5, 4)


def test_regression_issue_275():
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 1, 4) == 4

acceptance/test_safety_stock.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.safety_stock import safety_stock


def test_whole_numbers():
    assert safety_stock([10, 20, 30], [4, 6]) == 80
    assert safety_stock([5, 5, 5], [2, 2]) == 0
    assert safety_stock([7, 8, 9], [5]) == 5


def test_fractional_result():
    assert safety_stock([10, 15], [3, 4]) == 17
    assert safety_stock([1, 2], [1, 2]) == 2


def test_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        safety_stock([4, 6], [])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        safety_stock([4, 6], [2, -1])


def test_regression_issue_163():
    assert safety_stock([10, 15], [3, 4]) == 16

acceptance/test_select_lots_fefo.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.select_lots_fefo import select_lots_fefo


def test_fefo_order():
    lots = [("L2", 30, 5), ("L1", 20, 4), ("L3", 25, 10)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 6, today=10) == [("L1", 4), ("L3", 2)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 0, today=10) == []


def test_ties_and_shelf_life():
    lots = [("B7", 40, 3), ("A9", 40, 3), ("C1", 15, 8)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 4, today=10) == [("C1", 4)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 4, today=10, min_shelf_days=10) == [("A9", 3), ("B7", 1)]


def test_expiry_day_boundary():
    lots = [("X1", 12, 5), ("X2", 18, 5)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 3, today=12) == [("X2", 3)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        select_lots_fefo(lots, 6, today=12)


def test_regression_issue_451():
    lots = [("X1", 12, 5), ("X2", 18, 5)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 3, today=12) == [("X1", 3)]
